title: A Friendship Across Distance
text:
Anna and Marco are good friends. They met at school when they were ten years old. Every Saturday, they play football together in the park. Anna is always happy when she sees Marco.

Last year, Marco moved to another city. He was sad to leave his friend. But they talk on the phone every week. Anna says that a good friend is always close, even from far away.

questions.text: Where did Anna and Marco meet?
How often do Anna and Marco talk on the phone?
What can we infer about Anna and Marco's friendship?
options: They live in the same house
They talk regularly despite the distance
They never talk to each other

questions.text: What is the main idea of the second paragraph?
options: A friendship can stay strong at a distance
Marco does not like his new city
Anna wants to move to another city

vocabulary.definition: changed the place where you live
near in distance or in a relationship
used for each one in a repeated series

paragraph_translations: Anna e Marco são bons amigos. Eles se conheceram na escola quando tinham dez anos. Todo sábado, eles jogam futebol juntos no parque. Anna fica sempre feliz quando vê Marco.
No ano passado, Marco mudou-se para outra cidade. Ele ficou triste por deixar seu amigo. Mas eles conversam por telefone toda semana. Anna diz que um bom amigo está sempre perto, mesmo de longe.
